title: YOLO-Based Obstacle Detection
summary: Obstacle detection using YOLO to assist navigation.

caseStudy.problem: Detect obstacles in real-time for navigation.
caseStudy.approach: Leverage YOLO with fine-tuned dataset and OpenCV pipeline.
caseStudy.implementation: Python + OpenCV, model inference, bounding boxes, tracking.
caseStudy.learnings: Optimizing model and pre/post-processing matters for speed.

caseStudy.learnings: Data quality and augmentation are critical.

caseStudy.approach: Feature engineering on sensor data, anomaly detection.
